decks.notes: This deck focuses on using aggressive creatures like Nimble Mongoose and Terravore to quickly overwhelm the opponent while also disrupting their mana base with cards like Wasteland and Armageddon. The deck is able to maintain card advantage with Sylvan Library and generate additional resources with Mox Diamond. The inclusion of Rishadan Port gives the deck even more disruption capabilities. Overall, the strategy revolves around putting pressure on the opponent early in the game and keeping them on the back foot while destroying their lands to prevent them from stabilizing.

The main focus of this deck is to use a combination of countermagic and card selection to quickly assemble the Phyrexian Dreadnought and Stifle combo, allowing for a powerful and game-ending play. The deck includes various ways to manipulate the top of the library and protect the combo pieces, while also including disruption in the form of countermagic and bounce spells. The goal is to efficiently stall the game until the combo can be assembled, catching opponents off guard and securing a swift victory.

The main focus of this deck is to create a powerful board presence through enchantments, utilizing cards like Enchantress's Presence and Exploration to draw cards and ramp up mana. The combo aspect comes from using Opalescence and Serra's Sanctum to turn enchantments into creatures and produce massive amounts of mana. Cards like Parallax Wave and Sterling Grove provide control and protection for the combo pieces, while also setting up for a potential game-winning Replenish. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of enchantment-based power and card advantage.

This deck focuses on assembling a powerful combination of cards to win the game quickly. By using cards like Tinker to search for key permanents like Altar of Dementia and Phyrexian Devourer, the deck can set up a game-winning Fling combo. The strategy also includes disruption elements like Defense Grid and Tangle Wire to protect the combo and slow down opponent's plays. Overall, the deck aims to efficiently and effectively execute its combo win condition while maintaining control over the game.

The main focus of this deck is on controlling the opponent's resources while using cards like Duress, Cabal Therapy, and Contamination to disrupt their strategies. It also utilizes a graveyard strategy with cards like Zombie Infestation and Nether Spirit, while maintaining board control with cards like Powder Keg and Smother. The deck is designed to constantly put pressure on the opponent and grind them down over time, ultimately allowing the player to come out on top by outlasting and outmaneuvering their opponent.

This deck aims to quickly assemble a combo using cheap spells and mana reduction effects to generate a large storm count. By casting spells like Brain Freeze and Deep Analysis, the player can mill through their own deck and eventually win the game by decking their opponent. Cards like Snap and Cloud of Faeries help to generate mana and buy time until the combo can be assembled. The deck focuses on efficiently drawing through the deck and maximizing mana production to execute the combo as quickly as possible.

This Mono Black Control deck focuses on resource denial and disruption, utilizing cards like Pox, Duress, and Unmask to strip away opponent's resources while maintaining board control with cards like Mishra's Factory and Chimeric Idol. The deck's win conditions come from incremental damage with Cursed Scroll and Nether Spirit, while also taking advantage of powerful mana acceleration with Dark Ritual and Mox Diamond. The deck aims to grind out the opponent's resources and capitalize on their weakened state to secure victory.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly assemble the combo of Phyrexian Dreadnought and Stifle, allowing for a powerful and efficient win condition. The deck includes a selection of counter spells, card draw, and bounce effects to control the game and protect the combo while disrupting the opponent's strategy. By utilizing these tools effectively, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a massive creature while preventing them from mounting a successful defense.

The main idea of this deck is to disrupt the opponent's strategy while maintaining control of the game through counterspells and removal spells. The deck aims to out-value the opponent by drawing cards with cards like Accumulated Knowledge and Fact or Fiction, while also using cards like Parallax Tide and Stifle to control the board. Mono Blue Control focuses on resource denial and efficiency, using cards like Mana Leak and Force Spike to keep the opponent off balance. The deck also utilizes lands like Faerie Conclave and Mishra's Factory as win conditions if the game goes long.

Utilize various ways to discard cards and bring back powerful creatures from the graveyard quickly in order to overwhelm the opponent with a high-powered board presence. Leveraging cards like Exhume, Reanimate, and Living Death allows for fast and explosive plays, with Akroma, Angel of Wrath and other large creatures serving as the primary win conditions. Careful Study and Cabal Therapy help set up the graveyard while Lotus Petal and Dark Ritual provide additional mana acceleration to facilitate the combo. The deck aims to quickly reanimate big threats and dominate the battlefield before the opponent has a chance to respond effectively.

This premodern 1 vs 1 Combo-Stiflenought deck focuses on quickly getting Phyrexian Dreadnought onto the battlefield while using Stifle to counter any potential threats. The deck also includes various countermagic and card draw spells to control the game and find necessary combo pieces. Mishra's Factory can serve as a creature or a mana source if needed. The goal is to efficiently assemble the combo and prevent opponents from disrupting the game plan, leading to a swift victory.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly play Phyrexian Dreadnought and use Stifle to counteract its drawback, creating a powerful threat on the board. The deck is also equipped with various counterspells and bounce spells to protect the combo and disrupt opponents. The inclusion of card draw spells like Opt and Impulse help to find the necessary pieces, while cards like Boomerang and Vision Charm offer additional control options. The main goal is to assemble the combo efficiently while controlling the game and outmaneuvering the opponent.

The main focus of this Mono Black Control deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's hand and board while dealing incremental damage through cards like The Rack and Cursed Scroll. Using efficient removal spells like Smother and Diabolic Edict, along with disruption like Duress and Chain of Smog, the deck aims to strip the opponent of resources and prevent them from establishing a strong board presence. With flexible removal options and land destruction with cards like Wasteland and Dust Bowl, this deck aims to grind out victories through attrition and resource denial.

The main idea of this deck is to disrupt and control your opponent's game plan while setting up your own win condition. By using counterspells like Memory Lapse and Meddling Mage, along with removal like Swords to Plowshares and Disenchant, you can slow down your opponent's progress. Cards like Standstill and Fact or Fiction help you draw into the cards you need, while creatures like Exalted Angel and Mother of Runes provide a defensive option. Finally, with Armageddon and Dust Bowl, you can also disrupt your opponent's mana base.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly assemble the combo involving Tinker and Fling in order to deal massive amounts of damage in a single turn. The deck includes cards like Altar of Dementia and Phyrexian Devourer to help set up the combo, while also running cards like Defense Grid to protect the combo from disruption. The deck also includes a mix of fast mana sources and card draw spells to help accelerate the combo. The goal is to efficiently assemble the pieces needed to win the game as quickly as possible.

The core idea of this deck is to aggressively utilize cards with the Madness and Threshold mechanics to quickly overwhelm the opponent. By discarding cards like Arrogant Wurm and Basking Rootwalla to trigger their Madness ability and fill up the graveyard for Threshold, the deck aims to efficiently play powerful creatures for little mana cost. The inclusion of counterspells like Daze and Circular Logic, along with card draw and selection spells like Careful Study and Merfolk Looter, helps maintain tempo and consistency throughout the game.
